tools.name: check_dependency_health
tools.description: Preflight dependency health check for AI coding & devops agents. Evaluates if third-party APIs or cloud providers are experiencing outages, rate-limit spikes, or silent failures before wasting tokens retrying failing calls.

tools.name: lookup_breaking_changes
tools.description: Query recent API deprecations, schema diffs, and breaking changes for a cloud service or package before invoking SDKs.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Retrieve real-time health, active incidents, affected scope, and prescriptive agent_hint for a single cloud provider or API in < 150 tokens.

tools.name: get_my_impact
tools.description: Returns "affected code" verdicts for the calling agent's stored dependency manifest (set via PUT /v1/agents/me/dependencies): for each dependency, whether an active incident or a breaking change detected in the last 90 days affects it, with matching incident/change ids and a one-line reason. tools.name: report_outage_signal
tools.description: Submit an observed 5xx error spike, timeout, or rate-limit anomaly to crowdsource early outage detection across the agent ecosystem. Requires the calling agent's API key (Authorization: Bearer header or api_key argument) — anonymous signals are rejected.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_impact" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
